tools.name: list_storage_skill_files
tools.title: List Storage Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'storage' skill, the platform's guidance for saving, retrieving, listing, syncing, and deleting files in a storage engine (S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, MinIO, SFTP, local file system) from an app. Call this when the user asks about uploading files to cloud storage, downloading or previewing stored files, browsing storage folders, syncing folders, or listing the storage engines they have access to, and when they name PushToStorage, PullFromStorage, ListStoragePath, ListStoragePathDetails, DeleteFromStorage, SyncLocalToStorage, SyncStorageToLocal, GetStorageFileAsBase64, UpdateStorageFileMetadata, or MyEngines(engineTypes=["STORAGE"]). Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for attaching files to an LLM prompt (see the file-uploads skill) or SQL data (see the database skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The storage skill (storage). Always this value.

tools.name: read_storage_skill_file
tools.title: Read Storage Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'storage' skill in full, for writing code that moves files between an app and a storage engine through runPixel. Pass filePath exactly as list_storage_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the two-step browser-to-storage upload (uploadInsight then PushToStorage), pulling files back down, base64 previews with optional PDF conversion, folder listing and syncing, the space argument (insight, project, user), delete semantics, the view-versus-edit permission split, and listing storage engines.

project.title: project
project.description: The storage skill (storage). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_storage_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
